title: Giraffe holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f6c344'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='22' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='64' r='4' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='76' r='4' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='78' r='3' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f6c344'/>
  <rect x='55' y='82' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f6c344'/>
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='55' y='82' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- hoofs -->
  <rect x='29.5' y='91' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <rect x='54.5' y='91' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q66 40 62 24 L72 24 Q76 44 68 64 Z' fill='#f6c344'/>
  <path d='M60 62 Q66 40 62 24 L72 24 Q76 44 68 64 Z' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='52' r='3' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='42' r='3' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='32' r='2.6' fill='#b5761a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='20' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f6c344'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='20' rx='11' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='22' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f3a94a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='12' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#e8a93c'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='11' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#e8a93c'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='63' y='10' width='2.5' height='6' rx='1.2' fill='#c98f1e'/>
  <rect x='70' y='10' width='2.5' height='6' rx='1.2' fill='#c98f1e'/>
  <circle cx='64.2' cy='9.5' r='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <circle cx='71.2' cy='9.5' r='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='18' r='2' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='67.7' cy='17.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='21' r='1' fill='#a5661e'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 66 Q18 70 20 78' fill='none' stroke='#c98f1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='79' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <!-- heart held in front (front hoof area) -->
  <path d='M46 84 C46 80 40 78 38 82 C36 86 42 90 46 93 C50 90 56 86 54 82 C52 78 46 80 46 84 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M46 84 C46 80 40 78 38 82 C36 86 42 90 46 93 C50 90 56 86 54 82 C52 78 46 80 46 84 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff9fb2' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- highlight on heart -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='83' rx='1.6' ry='1' fill='#ffd0d8' transform='rotate(-25 42 83)'/>
</svg>
